metadata.dcterms:title: Knots and the Maxwell Equations
metadata.dcterms:creator: Vancea, Ion V.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: In this chapter, we review the Ra˜nada ﬁeld line solutions of Maxwell’s equations in the vacuum, which describe a topologically non-trivial electro- magnetic ﬁeld, as well as their relation with the knot theory. Also, we present a generalization of these solutions to the non-linear electrodynamics recently published in the literature.
